note: Project brief -> edit decisions. Each field in brief.json picks one entry below; its effects are applied in order platform, market, age, stage, funnel, niche. level: added to the level. density: multiplies cards per minute. caption_scale: multiplies caption size. caption_modes: preferred caption styles (first that exists wins over the genre's). energy: music energy override. style: used when --style auto. Research date for platform numbers: 2026-09-15; see references/audience-and-market.md for sources.

tiktok.note: completion rate is the heaviest signal; ~70% completion benchmark; search uses captions, on-screen text and transcript

reels.note: shares and saves weigh above likes; Reels over 3 minutes stop being recommended to non-followers

shorts.note: ranked on watch time per impression; ~65% average view duration gate under 30 s, ~50% above

linkedin.note: professional feed, many watch muted at work; proof and clarity over hype

youtube_long.note: cards every few seconds tire a long viewer; chapters matter more

x_twitter.note: autoplay muted in feed; first frame must read as a claim

b2c.note: impulse and emotion; faster cuts, brighter look

b2b.note: multi-stakeholder, 60-180 day cycles; proof, numbers, case studies

b2g.note: compliance and trust first; no hype language

investor.note: market size, traction, team; every number on screen

creator.note: personality-led; kinetic captions and word hits

hackathon.note: judges scan many videos; claim, demo, proof inside 60-120 s

gen_z.note: fast pattern changes, self-aware humor, native platform style

millennial.note: value and credibility; how-to and story both work

gen_x.note: slower pace, larger text, clear benefit

boomer.note: largest captions, fewest effects, no flashes

mixed.note: design for the oldest meaningful segment's readability

idea.note: pre-product: build in public, problem interviews, honest and scrappy

pre_revenue.note: prototype or hackathon: demo and proof beat polish

growth.note: traction exists: social proof, case studies, offers

scale.note: brand building: consistent look, fewer gimmicks

enterprise.note: brand safety and consistency; restraint signals quality

conversion.note: optimize clicks; one offer, one action

web3_crypto.compliance: Not financial advice. Never promise returns. Many regions regulate crypto promotion.

finance.compliance: Not financial advice. Show risk. Regulated claims need a licensed review.

health_fitness.compliance: No medical claims or cure language. Results vary; say so.

beauty_fashion.compliance: Disclose paid partnerships and gifted products.

gaming.compliance: Game footage may be copyrighted; check the publisher's video policy.

real_estate.compliance: Housing ads have anti-discrimination rules in many regions.

parenting.compliance: Children on camera: consent and privacy.

local_business.compliance: Prices and promos must be accurate on the date posted.

entertainment.compliance: Clips from films, shows and songs are usually claimed.

funnel_defaults.note: Placeholder conversion assumptions for the revenue calculator. Replace with the user's own analytics; these are not benchmarks.
